    Taxonomies & Barreno et al.~\cite{BNJT10}, Papernot et al.~\cite{PMSW18}, NIST AI 100-2~\cite{VOFADH25} & The terms for the stage, the goal, the adversary's knowledge and its capability. & They prove nothing. None has an axis for which parties the adversary controls (found by us). Only NIST puts privacy and integrity on one page. \\
    Federated SoKs & Carletti et al.~\cite{CFMPV25}, Mansouri et al.~\cite{MOJC23}, Rizzini et al.~\cite{REGB26} & Threat models by role inside one setting, such as eight server models for gradient inversion, one a server with Sybil clients. & Each covers one setting and one family of attacks (found by us). \\
    Security games & Yeom et al.~\cite{YGFJ18}, Salem et al.~\cite{SCEKPSTZ23}, Wu et al.~\cite{WZLLHL23}, Li et al.~\cite{LLLKPMW24} & What it means that the adversary can tell, for a released model or for gradients, with reductions between goals. & Salem et al.: one challenger trains one model, and games do not express concurrent protocols (stated, Sec. VI-D). Wu et al.: integrity only, with no advantage. Li et al.: gradients only, the final model is not attacked. \\
    Protocol simulation & Mansouri et al.~\cite{MOJC23}, Ma et al.~\cite{MWAPR23}, HE-OFT~\cite{KSK26}, Morona-M\'{\i}nguez et al.~\cite{MPP26} & The protocol reveals nothing beyond the output of an ideal functionality, against a named coalition. & What that output leaks is taken as given, for instance the sum in secure aggregation. A CKKS instantiation is approximate, so it realizes the functionality only up to an error. \\
    Protocol with a mechanism on the output & Pentyala et al.~\cite{PRMMDND22}, and the joined ledger papers & MPC or HE for the protocol and DP on the released value, in one construction. & Each proof covers its own protocol and functionality. No search found a definitional framework. \\
    Games in another domain & Villa et al.~\cite{VDKMR26} & One game for confidentiality, integrity and availability. & Its object is an agentic LLM system, not parties training together. \\
    Standards & IEEE 3652.1~\cite{IEEE3652}, ISO/IEC 4922-1~\cite{ISO4922}, ISO/IEC 28033-1~\cite{ISO28033}, NIST SP 800-226~\cite{NISTSP800226} & Vocabulary for federated learning, MPC, FHE and DP, and the unit of privacy. & None fixes attack scenarios. ISO/IEC 28033 is a draft, and the full text of IEEE 3652.1 was not seen. \\
    Method & Desfontaines and Pej\'o~\cite{DP20} & Criteria for the dimensions of a taxonomy: inner exclusivity and mutual compatibility. & Applied to variants of DP, not to attack scenarios. \\
